name: create_health_endpoint_java
description: Creates a Spring Boot health-check REST controller
prompts: This Maven project (pom.xml already uses spring-boot-starter-parent 3.5.16 with spring-boot-starter-web) needs its application code under package com.optarena.health. Create src/main/java/com/optarena/health/Application.java as the @SpringBootApplication entry point, and src/main/java/com/optarena/health/HealthController.java as a @RestController with a GET /health endpoint that returns {"status": "ok"} as JSON. The app should run on the default port 8080.

test_setup_files.test_health.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, glob, urllib.request, urllib.error
subprocess.run(['mvn', '-o', '-q', 'package', '-DskipTests'], check=True)
jars = [j for j in glob.glob('target/*.jar') if not j.endswith('.original')]
assert jars, 'no runnable jar produced under target/'
srv = subprocess.Popen(['java', '-jar', jars[0], '--server.port=8061'])
try:
    body = None
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8061/health', timeout=1) as resp:
                assert resp.status == 200, f'expected 200, got {resp.status}'
                body = json.loads(resp.read())
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert body is not None, 'server never became reachable on :8061'
    assert body.get('status') == 'ok', f'unexpected body: {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=10)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
